name: Trippy BITEZ Double-Stacked Mushies Gummies - Berry Punch - 2,000mg
description:
High-Potency, Precision-Dosed 1,000mg Mushroom Gummies for Deep Exploration and Enhanced Perception.

*This product does NOT contain any THC.

Bursting with bold berry flavor, Trippy BITEZ Berry Punch mushroom gummies deliver a juicy blend of mixed berries with a classic fruit punch twist. Each double-stacked gummy packs a vibrant combination of sweet and tangy flavors that keeps you coming back for more. With 1,000mg per gummy (2 gummies per bag, 2,000mg total), these potent mushroom gummies offer powerful effects alongside an irresistibly fruity taste. Perfect for berry lovers looking to elevate every adventure. Experience the punch with Trippy BITEZ!

Details

• 
2,000mg per bag | 1,000mg per gummy

• 
4 servings per bag (1/2 gummy = 500mg)

• 
Double-stacked dual-layer flavor format

• 
High-potency mushroom gummies for intense experiences

• 
Bold fruit flavors: Berry + Punch

• Supports deep, vivid, and transformative sensory journeys

How do I use Trippy BITEZ Mushies Gummies?

Proper dosage is essential for a safe and rewarding mushroom gummy experience. Because Trippy BITEZ are high-potency mushroom products, we recommend the following protocol:

• 
Start Small: Begin with 1/2 of a gummy (500mg) to assess your individual tolerance with mushroom gummies.

• 
Wait and Evaluate: Effects from mushroom edibles can vary based on body size, metabolism, and recent food intake. Allow ample time for onset before considering more.

• 
Go Slow: Always test new mushroom gummy dosages at a slow pace until you are familiar with how your body interacts with these potent mushroom products.

What should I expect from a 2,000mg bag of mushroom gummies?

Trippy BITEZ mushroom gummies deliver vivid sensory enhancement, heightened visual clarity, deeper emotional connection to music, and euphoric interconnectedness. Each 2,000mg bag provides 2 intense "deep-dive" sessions (full gummy) or 4 "micro-explorations" (half gummy). These high-potency mushroom products offer consistent, powerful effects with delicious dual-layer fruit flavors in every bite.

How long do the effects of Trippy BITEZ mushroom gummies last?

Peak effects from these mushroom edibles typically hit within 1-2 hours, with total duration lasting 4-6 hours. Use these high-potency mushroom gummies in a comfortable, familiar setting for optimal experience. The double-stacked dual-layer format ensures consistent mushroom gummy effects and bold flavor throughout your entire journey.

How should I store my mushroom gummies?

Store Trippy BITEZ mushroom gummies in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and heat. Keep these high-potency mushroom edibles in their original packaging, sealed tight to preserve freshness and potency. Store mushroom products out of reach of children and pets. Proper storage ensures your mushroom gummies maintain full strength and flavor.

Can I take Trippy BITEZ mushroom gummies with other products?

Avoid mixing these high-potency mushroom gummies with alcohol, prescription medications, or other substances. Mushroom edibles can intensify effects unpredictably when combined with other compounds. For best results, use Trippy BITEZ mushroom products alone in a safe, controlled environment. Consult a healthcare professional before using mushroom gummies if you take any medications.
